신서고 부교재 · 상관접속사와 병렬
주제찾기
1 1번 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
Researchers played a series of weak jokes to 72 listeners. Each joke was followed by silence, by pretend laughter, or by genuine laughter. Listeners then scored how amusing each joke seemed to them. Jokes met with silence scored lowest of all. Pretend laughter lifted the scores by about a tenth. Genuine laughter lifted them by roughly a fifth. So what we hear around a joke shapes how funny the joke feels. Laughter, it seems, spreads between people and draws them closer.
①the techniques comedians use to write more effective jokes
②why some listeners are harder to amuse than others
③how the laughter surrounding a joke changes our judgment of it
④the health benefits that regular laughter brings to the body
⑤how researchers design experiments with large numbers of subjects
2 2번 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
Cars that drive themselves and connect to the internet will soon fill our roads. Specialists caution that every added connection is another door for an intruder. In a recent trial, engineers seized a car that another person was driving. From a laptop they altered the stereo, the climate control and the wipers. They then reached the gearbox and brought the moving vehicle to a halt. It was only a trial, yet the warning to carmakers and lawmakers was unmistakable.
①the engineering steps required to build a fully self-driving car
②the declining demand for skilled mechanics in the motor trade
③the environmental advantages of replacing older cars with new ones
④the legal difficulty of deciding who is at fault in a car accident
⑤the security risk created by connecting more vehicles to the internet

신서고 부교재 · 상관접속사와 병렬
주제찾기
3 3번 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
Beyond the atmosphere an orbiting craft moves fast enough to cancel the pull of gravity. Riders on a roller coaster meet a smaller version of the same effect. Climbing the track, gravity presses the body into the seat. Plunging down, the body floats until the belt catches it. NASA borrows this trick for its training programme. An aircraft climbs to twenty-four thousand feet and then dives. For twenty to twenty-five seconds those aboard weigh nothing at all. The flights also let the agency run experiments and try out equipment.
①the history of the earliest crewed missions into orbit
②why gravity is weaker at high altitudes than at sea level
③the design of engines powerful enough to reach orbit
④how NASA reproduces weightlessness on Earth to prepare astronauts
⑤the physical dangers that roller coasters pose to their riders
4 4번 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
An email from a vegetable sounds absurd, yet it can happen. Engineers fitted spinach with sensors that react to certain chemicals in the ground. Those chemicals are the ones commonly present in explosives. When the sensor fires, a nearby computer emails the research team. The original aim was to see whether spinach could find buried explosives. The same method could also gather data on drought, soil and water. Pollution monitoring and climate work are within its reach as well.
①using living plants as sensors that report on their surroundings
②the nutritional value of spinach compared with other vegetables
③the difficulty of removing explosives from former battlefields
④new email technologies designed for scientific laboratories
⑤the effect of soil chemistry on the growth rate of crops

신서고 부교재 · 상관접속사와 병렬
요지찾기
5 1번 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
In one study, 72 people listened to a set of corny jokes. After each joke came either no laughter, fake laughter, or real laughter. The listeners rated how funny they found every joke. Jokes that landed in silence received poor ratings. Fake laughter raised the rating by ten percent. Real laughter raised it by twenty percent. Both kinds of laughter therefore changed how funny the jokes seemed. We judge a joke partly by the response it receives from others.
①농담의 완성도가 높을수록 청중의 웃음도 커진다.
②실험 참가자의 수가 많을수록 결과의 신뢰도가 높아진다.
③농담의 재미는 그 농담이 받는 웃음이라는 반응에 크게 좌우된다.
④유머 감각은 타고나는 것이 아니라 훈련으로 길러진다.
⑤진짜 웃음과 가짜 웃음은 청중에게 전혀 다르게 인식된다.
6 2번 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
Internet-connected self-driving cars are about to become common. Experts warn that their benefits arrive together with a new danger. Researchers showed this by taking over a car from a computer while it was being driven. They changed the radio and air conditioning, then took the transmission and stopped the car. The test was harmless, but the lesson was not. Carmakers and governments alike must treat automotive cybersecurity as a real problem.
①해킹 시연은 실제 위협이 아니므로 지나치게 걱정할 필요가 없다.
②연결된 자율주행차가 늘수록 해킹 위험이 커져 보안이 시급하다.
③자율주행차는 사람이 운전하는 차보다 사고율이 훨씬 낮아 안전하다.
④정부는 자율주행차의 도로 주행을 당분간 전면 금지해야 한다.
⑤자동차 회사들은 라디오와 에어컨 같은 편의 장치를 줄여야 한다.

요지찾기
7 3번 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
Astronauts feel no weight outside the atmosphere because orbital speed offsets gravity. A roller coaster offers a familiar taste of the same sensation. Going up, gravity pushes the rider down into the seat. Rushing down, the rider hangs in the air until the safety belt pulls. NASA uses this phenomenon deliberately. Its aircraft climbs high and dives, giving about twenty to twenty-five seconds of weightlessness. Astronauts get used to the environment of space this way. The same flights let NASA conduct experiments and test equipment.
①우주선의 속도가 빨라질수록 탑승자가 느끼는 중력도 강해진다.
②우주비행사 훈련은 대부분 지상 시뮬레이터에서 이루어진다.
③NASA는 급강하 비행으로 짧은 무중력을 만들어 훈련에 쓴다.
④무중력 상태는 지구에서는 결코 재현할 수 없는 특별한 현상이다.
⑤롤러코스터는 우주비행사 선발을 위한 공식 시험 장비로 쓰인다.
8 4번 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
You are unlikely to get an email from a vegetable, but it is not impossible. Engineers placed devices in spinach that send a signal when they sense certain compounds. Those compounds are commonly found in explosives. The signal makes a small computer email the engineers. The study asked whether spinach could detect explosives. The technology, though, has much broader potential. Plants may be able to warn us about droughts, pollution and climate change.
①기후변화를 막으려면 농작물 재배 방식을 바꾸어야 한다.
②식물에 심은 센서가 폭발물을 넘어 환경 변화까지 알려 줄 수 있다.
③시금치는 다른 채소보다 화학 물질을 잘 흡수하는 특별한 작물이다.
④이메일은 과학 연구에서 가장 빠른 정보 전달 수단이다.
⑤폭발물 탐지는 기계보다 식물이 언제나 더 정확하다.

9 1번 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
Seventy-two volunteers sat and listened to a run of dad jokes. Some jokes were followed by nothing, some by forced laughter, some by real laughter. The volunteers scored each joke for how funny it was. Silence produced the lowest scores. Forced laughter added ten percent to the score. Real laughter added twenty percent. Hearing others laugh readies us to laugh along. That is why laughter both sharpens a joke and binds a room together.
①Why a Joke Gets Funnier When Someone Else Laughs
②The Lost Art of Writing a Perfect Punchline
③Measuring Intelligence Through a Sense of Humor
④How Comedians Train Audiences to Respond on Cue
⑤Silence: The Most Powerful Tool in Comedy
10 2번 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
Soon a great many self-driving cars with internet access will share our roads. These cars bring real benefits, but experts point to a cost that comes with them. A demonstration proved that even the smart cars of today can be broken into. Working from a computer, researchers controlled a car while someone else drove it. They handled the radio and the wipers, then the transmission, stopping the car outright. Automotive cybersecurity, the demonstration said plainly, is a real issue.
①Self-Driving Cars Will End Traffic Jams for Good
②Every New Connection Is a New Door for Hackers
③Why Drivers Still Prefer to Hold the Steering Wheel
④The Race to Build the Fastest Electric Vehicle
⑤How Insurance Companies Price a Modern Car

Astronauts feel weightless when they travel outside our planet's atmosphere because the speed of a spacecraft in orbit balances the force of Earth's gravitational pull. In fact, you may have experienced a similar feeling when riding a roller coaster. As the roller coaster car climbs up the track, gravity pulls your body downward, and you feel yourself pushing down on your seat. However, when the car rushes down, your body hangs in the air until it is pulled down by your safety belt. Using this phenomenon, NASA prepares its astronauts for space travel. The astronauts fly in an aircraft that ascends to an altitude of 24,000 feet, and once the aircraft dives down, the passengers experience about 20 to 25 seconds of weightlessness. These flights help astronauts get used to the environment of space, and they allow NASA to conduct experiments and test equipment in a similar environment as well.
